sources.title: GLM-5.3 | OpenLM.ai
sources.snippet: GLM-5 supports controlling the thinking budget through the reasoning_effort parameter, which accepts two levels: max and high. max is the default — if reasoning_effort is left unset (or set to any value other than high), the model runs at Max.
